lines.text: Singapore's Health Information Act is here, and every healthcare provider now has a date.
Patient records will now follow the patient. So every provider that shares data must protect it, whatever its size.
GP clinics, hospitals, labs and radiology must be ready by September 2027. Grant applications close the week before.
The security essentials cover your whole estate: every PC and laptop, imaging systems, analysers, even paper records.
When an incident is notifiable, the Ministry must be told within two hours. That takes a round-the-clock team, not a policy document.
Government funding helps. Three schemes cover clinical systems, security advice and tooling: around twenty thousand Singapore dollars for a single clinic.
Most providers get a report, or a tool. You need someone who owns the outcome, with round-the-clock cover behind them.
That's TAFA, HexaShield's exclusive healthcare partner. TAFA owns your programme locally. HexaShield powers it, with HexaView and a 24/7 security operation.
In HexaView, you see every Health Information Act control, your record-sharing readiness and Cyber Essentials progress, with evidence on demand.
For hospitals and labs, HexaOT watches the connected medical devices that can't simply be patched.
Twelve months, worked backwards from the grant deadline: assess, plan, fix, certify, and stay compliant.
Start with a free discovery call. We'll map every licence, every deadline, and what you can claim. TAFA, powered by HexaShield.
